name: Hiveflow
description:
Hiveflow is a visual AI agent orchestrator: you design workflows on a drag-and-drop canvas, connect them to your tools and data, and let them run on a schedule, from a trigger, or on demand. This connector brings your Hiveflow workspace into Claude, so you can inspect and operate it in conversation instead of switching to the dashboard.

What you can do with it:

• Flows — list your workflows with their execution state, inspect a flow's nodes and edges, create new flows, run one on demand, and activate or pause it.
• Kanban boards — list boards, read columns and cards, create cards, move them between columns, and add comments.
• Workers — see which agents are connected to a board, whether they are paused, and when they last checked in. Moving a card into a watched column is how you hand work to them.
• Organizations and workspaces — list the organizations and workspaces you belong to, and scope any operation to a specific one.
• Live API reference — a docs tool that returns the current Hiveflow API reference, so Claude works from up-to-date definitions rather than assumptions.

Everything runs with your own Hiveflow account through OAuth: the connector sees exactly what you see, respects your organization roles and permissions, and every action is attributed to you. Tools that only read are marked read-only; tools that change your account — running a flow, pausing one, moving a card — are marked as such, so Claude asks before acting.

Free to connect with any Hiveflow account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hiveflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hiveflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hiveflow.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hiveflow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiveflow lists 15 MCP tools, including comment_card, create_card, create_flow, docs, get_board, get_flow, list_boards, list_flows, list_organizations, list_workers, list_workspaces, and move_card.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hiveflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hiveflow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Hiveflow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hiveflow is developed by Hiveflow Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
